## 5. Clinical Recommendations

### Immediate Pre-Transfer Actions
```
BEFORE TRANSFER — CONSIDER:

1. ENDOMETRIAL DOPPLER ASSESSMENT
   └── Uterine artery PI/RI measurement
       If PI >3.0 or absent end-diastolic flow:
       → Consider cycle cancellation/freeze-all

2. LUTEAL PHASE OPTIMIZATION
   ├── Ensure vaginal progesterone ≥600mg/day or
   │   equivalent (IM P4 if thin endometrium history)
   ├── Add low-dose aspirin 75–100mg/day if not
   │   already prescribed (endometrial perfusion)
   └── Consider Vitamin E 400–600IU + L-arginine
       for endometrial vascularization

3. LOW BMI COUNSELING
   └── Nutritional support — caloric density 
       optimization without rapid weight change
```

### Transfer Protocol
```
TRANSFER DAY RECOMMENDATIONS:
├── Confirm endometrial echo pattern (trilaminar ✓)
├── Embryo warming assessment before transfer
├── Consider elective single embryo transfer (eSET)
│   └── Rationale: prior biochemical — unclear if
│       implantation or early loss etiology
└── Mock embryo transfer review if not done
```

### Post-Transfer
```
LUTEAL SUPPORT:
├── Progesterone supplementation through 10–12 weeks
├── βhCG at day 9–10 post-transfer
├── If biochemical: repeat at 48h for doubling
└── Early viability scan at 6–7 weeks if positive
```

### Future Cycle Planning (if this cycle fails)
```
INVESTIGATIVE WORKUP RECOMMENDED:

TIER 1 — Standard
├── Hysteroscopy (rule out endometrial polyp,
│   adhesion, septum — prior biochemical)
├── Uterine cavity saline sonohysterography
└── Endometrial receptivity analysis (ERA biopsy)
    └── Personalized embryo transfer (pET) timing

TIER 2 — Consider
├── Thrombophilia screening
│   └── Biochemical pregnancy → possible factor V,
│       MTHFR, antiphospholipid antibody
├── NK cell / immunological workup
│   └── Peripheral blood NKs, uterine NK biopsy
├── Sperm DNA fragmentation (SDF) testing
│   └── Biochemical → early embryo loss mechanism
└── Karyotype (both partners) if repeated failure

LIFESTYLE/OPTIMIZATION:
├── BMI optimization — target 19.5–23
├── Stress reduction — consider referral to
│   mind-body program (evidence-based benefit)
└── Continue current exercise/dietary habits
```
